name: coreutils
purpose: The everyday file commands (ls, cp, mv, cat, head, tail, sort, wc, sha256sum and about 100 more), the same on every system.

name: pfind
purpose: Finds files and text on the whole disk fast, on every core, and never loops through junctions.

name: ast-grep
purpose: Searches and rewrites source code by its structure, not by plain text.

name: difft
purpose: Shows what changed between two files by the code's structure, so moved lines are not noise.

name: sd
purpose: Find and replace text in files, with simple regular expressions.

name: hyperfine
purpose: Times a command many times and reports the average, to compare two ways of doing a job.

name: ninja
purpose: Runs the compile steps of a build as fast as the machine allows.

name: 7za
purpose: Packs and unpacks 7z, zip, tar and other archives.

name: ffmpeg
purpose: Converts, cuts and extracts audio and video.

name: ffprobe
purpose: Reads what is inside a video or audio file: length, codecs, size.

name: cwebp
purpose: Turns PNG and JPEG pictures into smaller WebP pictures.

name: avifenc
purpose: Turns PNG and JPEG pictures into much smaller AVIF pictures.

name: oxipng
purpose: Makes PNG pictures smaller without changing a single pixel.
